"""Compilado pelo TestForge v2 — cadeia de fallback executa no LocatorResolver em runtime."""
from playwright.sync_api import Page
from testforge.runtime import step

BASE_URL = "https://assert.exemplo/"

def test_golden_assertion_immutable(page: Page):
    """web — source: assertion_immutable."""
    step.go(page, BASE_URL)
    step.click(page, intent="click button \"Calcular\"", candidates_file="step_001.json")
    step.assert_text(page, intent="assert \"R$ 3.333,33\"", expected="R$ 3.333,33", candidates_file="step_002.json")
    step.assert_text(page, intent="assert \"Continuar\"", expected="Continuar", candidates_file="step_003.json")
